items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: I toured with Pass and Review, 1933, with Joe Glaser

ctx.x: I never will forget Louie -- we just got into a place in Washington, Washington, D.C., and Joe Glaser says, 'We're going to broadcast,' and I said, 'Louie just got in he's got his cot down, and he's and (unintelligible) going to sleep.' He said, 'Well, he'll have to get up because we're going to broad --' I said, 'No, Louie got to have his rest. The man has got to have his rest. The man is tired. Louie is not going to broadcast.' That made Joe mad and made his wife mad -- not Lucille now, this was Alpha -- this…
